name: Bulldozer

attack.name: China-Shop Charge
attack.telegraph: Lowers its head, paws the earth. It is not going around the tree. It has never gone around anything.

weaknesses: it never goes around — position accordingly

edible.note: Pork is pork. Smoke it; it keeps for weeks. The quills make excellent awls.

codexStages.unknown: Something heavy moved in the thicket. Then a tree fell over for no reason.
codexStages.observed: Feral hog. The System observed 'bull in a china shop' and concluded destruction is the point. It charges through obstacles — trees, fences, you. It cannot be deterred, only redirected.
codexStages.slain: Thornback Boar. Moves: China-Shop Charge (heavy, telegraphed, destroys cover), Trample (close range after a missed charge), Retreat (below 25% hp, may return). It will not go around. Use that. Flanks are soft — harry it, then strike. Meat: excellent. The quills make fine awls.

attack.name: Silent Rush
attack.telegraph: No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving.

edible.note: Edible but lean. The old taboo itches; hunger doesn't care.

codexStages.unknown: The woods went silent all at once. Not quiet — silent. Like the world holding its breath.
codexStages.observed: Feral dogs. The System classified vocalization as 'inefficient' and removed it. They coordinate without sound — watch the lead animal's ears. They are still loyal. Just not to you.
codexStages.slain: Hushwolf. Moves: Silent Rush (ambush opener, heavy), Harass (pack circles, light hits), Withdraw (if the lead falls). They fear fire — they remember being dogs. Wound the lead and the pack breaks.

name: Highbeam Deer

attack.name: Ocular Discharge
attack.telegraph: It freezes. Like a deer in headlights. Light gathers behind its eyes. It is not frozen. It is aiming.

weaknesses: skittish at range before it locks on

edible.note: Venison. The best meat in the woods, and the saddest. Thank it.

codexStages.unknown: A deer. It froze like a deer in headlights. The light did not stop gathering.
codexStages.observed: Whitetail. The System observed the freeze response and classified it as ocular beam charging. It was wrong about the 'beam' — and right that you should move. When it freezes, it is aiming. Antlers never shed: the System classified them as permanent equipment.
codexStages.slain: Gallowdeer. Moves: Ocular Discharge (telegraphed by the freeze — MOVE), Antler Sweep (close range), Bolt (flees at 50% hp). Never let it finish aiming. The meat is worth the sorrow. Thank it.

name: Flashbulb Moth

attack.name: Wing Flash
attack.telegraph: It lands. It folds its wings. The light in the clearing changes, like someone adjusting a lamp.

weaknesses: attack from behind (it must face you to flash)

edible.note: Mostly wing. Crunchy. Tastes like dust and regret.

codexStages.unknown: A light in the trees that wasn't the sun. Then spots in your vision.
codexStages.observed: Luna moth. The System classified its wings as 'under-visible' and coated them in retroreflectors. It flashes to stun — not to hunt, just because it can. It doesn't want you. It wants to be SEEN.
codexStages.slain: Flashbulb Moth. Moves: Wing Flash (blinds 1 round, must be facing you), Drift (moves randomly, hard to predict). Kill it from behind or on cloudy days. The wing scales make excellent signal mirrors.

name: Choir Toad

attack.name: Resonant Croak
attack.telegraph: Its throat swells. The air goes thick. Every frog for a mile answers at once.

weaknesses: deafened by its own chorus (loud noises scatter the pack)

edible.note: Legs are fine. The throat sac is not food. Do not eat the throat sac.

codexStages.unknown: Frogs. Too many frogs. All croaking the same note, like a rehearsal.
codexStages.observed: Bullfrog. The System classified croaking as 'inefficient communication' and amplified it into resonance. They croak in chorus now — one croak, and the pack knows where you are. The sound carries for miles.
codexStages.slain: Choir Toad. Moves: Resonant Croak (sonic, calls the pack), Lunge (short range, clumsy). They hunt by sound — stay quiet or stay loud enough to break the chorus. The throat sac makes a fine waterskin.

name: Lockpick

attack.name: Disassemble
attack.telegraph: It sits up. Its hands move too fast to follow. Something you own is suddenly in its hands.

weaknesses: it steals before it fights — guard your pack

edible.note: Greasy. Fine in a stew. Wash your hands after handling — it touched everything you own.

codexStages.unknown: Your pack was open. You didn't open it. Something small is holding your knife.
codexStages.observed: Raccoon. The System observed tool use and concluded the hands were 'under-articulated.' It gave them more joints. It can now pick locks, untie knots, and disassemble a snare in seconds. It doesn't want to hurt you. It wants your stuff.
codexStages.slain: Lockpick. Moves: Disassemble (steals an item, may disarm traps), Bite (only if cornered). It steals FIRST and fights second — secure your pack. Distract it with food; it cannot resist food.

name: White Noise

attack.name: Spearfish Strike
attack.telegraph: The heron is gone. No — it's there. It was always there. You just couldn't see it until it moved.

weaknesses: it casts no shadow — watch the water, not the bird
it commits to the strike (dodge sideways)

edible.note: Fishy. Obviously. Everything about it is fishy.

codexStages.unknown: A heron-shaped absence by the creek. Then a beak where your hand was.
codexStages.observed: Great blue heron. The System classified shadows as 'visual noise' and removed the bird's. It is hardest to see when it is stillest — which is always. It strikes like a spear. It was always there. You just couldn't see it.
codexStages.slain: White Noise. Moves: Spearfish Strike (devastating lunge, telegraphed by stillness), Stalk (repositions unseen). Watch the water's surface, not the bird. When it commits, move sideways — it can't correct mid-strike.

name: Hummice

attack.name: Swarm Hum
attack.telegraph: A low hum rises from the grass. It harmonizes with itself. Your teeth ache.

weaknesses: the hum needs the swarm — scatter them

edible.note: One mouse is a snack. Fifty mice is a meal. Do the math.

codexStages.unknown: The grass hummed. Like a refrigerator. Like a choir warming up underground.
codexStages.observed: Field mice. The System networked them — a hive hum for coordination. Individually harmless. Together they vibrate at a frequency that loosens teeth and resolve. They don't bite so much as... overwhelm.
codexStages.slain: Hummice. Moves: Swarm Hum (stacking damage, worse the longer you stand in it), Nibble Tide (many small bites). Don't stand still. Scatter them — the hum needs the swarm. A cat would end this in minutes.

name: Speedbump

attack.name: Snap Decision
attack.telegraph: It doesn't move. It hasn't moved in an hour. Its head is suddenly somewhere else.

weaknesses: it cannot chase (it is a turtle)

edible.note: Excellent soup. Getting to the meat requires tools, patience, and forgiveness.

codexStages.unknown: A rock by the trail. The rock had opinions about your ankle.
codexStages.observed: Snapping turtle. The System classified its shell as 'inadequate coverage' and plated the gaps. It is now functionally a bunker with a bad attitude. It cannot chase you. It doesn't need to — you walked to it.
codexStages.slain: Speedbump. Moves: Snap Decision (blinding fast head strike, short range), Bunker (withdraws, nearly invulnerable). It can't follow. Walk around it. If you must fight: flip it, or don't. The soup is worth it.

name: Nightlight

attack.name: Lure and Grasp
attack.telegraph: A soft green glow under the water. Pretty. That's the problem — it's pretty.

weaknesses: the glow gives it away in dark water

edible.note: Good eating. The glow fades after death. Mostly.

codexStages.unknown: Something glowed in the creek at dusk. You reached for it. That was the idea.
codexStages.observed: Channel catfish. The System classified its lure as 'under-visible' and made it bioluminescent. It glows to attract — curious hands, small fish, you. The glow is beautiful. The teeth are not.
codexStages.slain: Nightlight. Moves: Lure and Grasp (ambush from dark water), Barb Lash (close range). Don't wade at night. If you must: the glow betrays it — strike where the light is, not where you think the fish is.
